draft.emotion: a light, breezy annoyance at a small mental slip, matter-of-fact
notes: Irregular verb: vergeten – vergat, vergaten – vergeten.

In the perfect tense, both 'zijn' and 'hebben' occur: use 'zijn' when you lost a memory (Ik ben zijn naam vergeten), and either 'hebben' or 'zijn' when you failed to do or bring something (Ik heb/ben mijn tas vergeten).

senses.definition: To fail to remember information or to neglect to do something.
